release_evidence.conclusion: Official release notes confirm built-in trade updates, event_id and trade cache health in 1.7.6; they do not close the eight semantic blockers.

items.evidence: event_id is documented for report deduplication and gap detection; order id equals deal trade_id; seqno, ordno and exchange_seq are exposed.
items.conclusion: The documented fields can be preserved and used only in their stated roles.
items.unknown: Uniqueness and rollover scope across account, process, reconnect and trading day are not specified; no field is a caller-controlled durable idempotency key.

items.evidence: update_status refreshes backend state and is prescribed after login or missed reports; list_trades is empty immediately after login until reconciliation.
items.conclusion: An ambiguous command outcome requires update_status and full reconciliation before any decision.
items.unknown: The documentation does not define an authoritative negative lookup or when absence permits safe resubmission.

items.evidence: After a new login update_status fetches the day's orders; trade_cache_health reports NoBaseline, SequenceGap, PendingReport, UntrackableEventId and ProjectionFailed.
items.conclusion: New login or reconnect remains kill-new-risk until update_status, order/deal baselines, cache health and local reconciliation pass.
items.unknown: End-to-end completeness across disconnect boundaries and the exact point at which both streams are authoritative are not guaranteed.

items.evidence: place, update and cancel generate callbacks; official documentation warns that a deal may arrive before its order event.
items.conclusion: Fills are authoritative facts and cumulative quantities must be reconciled before releasing reservations.
items.unknown: No official atomicity, precedence or exhaustive terminal-state table for cancel/replace/fill races was found.

items.evidence: The reconciliation page describes fetching the day's orders after login.
items.conclusion: Only a same-day order baseline is documented and must not be generalized.
items.unknown: Historical query availability, report retention horizon, midnight rollover and timezone boundary semantics are unspecified.

items.evidence: Official documentation describes API-key login, contract fetch, trade subscription and logout.
items.conclusion: Any disconnect or authentication failure is treated as session degradation and blocks new risk.
items.unknown: Token lifetime, idle expiry, renewal behavior, maintenance windows and production session SLA are not specified.

items.evidence: Order callbacks define op_code 00 as success and all other values as failure; op_msg, status_code and msg are exposed.
items.conclusion: Unknown provider codes remain UNKNOWN/OPERATOR_DECISION and must never be coerced to a nearby category.
items.unknown: No comprehensive versioned code catalog with retryability and terminality was found.

items.version: Shioaji 1.7.6 release notes and upgrade guides
items.evidence: Official release notes and upgrade guides document version-specific changes; 1.7.6 adds event identity and trade-cache behavior.
items.conclusion: A future adapter must pin an exact SDK version and repeat conformance and source review before upgrade.
items.unknown: Supported-version window, semantic-versioning guarantee, backward-compatibility promise and deprecation notice period are unspecified.
